articles.title: French Senate blocks new crypto tax and wallet list critics called a kidnapping risk
articles.snippet: The government opposed the measures citing existing EU data-sharing rules and non-legal tender status, leaving the 2027 budget open.

articles.title: Italy’s UniCredit launches six-year bitcoin certificate with gains capped at 65%
articles.snippet: UniCredit brings bitcoin investing to its roughly 8 million retail customers in Italy, offering them a six-year product that caps the redemption value but promises to return their capital.

articles.title: EU proposes $54.7 billion fund for AI, quantum startups alongside post-quantum security push
articles.snippet: Brussels wants tech firms to grow at home. EU scale-ups raise about half the capital of San Francisco peers by year 10, an EIB study found.

articles.title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
articles.snippet: Derive’s new options on Nvidia, Anthropic, stock indices and oil bring hedging tools to onchain RWA markets.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin pulls back below $60,000, stock rally fades, as tariffs re-enter the picture
articles.snippet: The Trump Administration could unveil tariff hikes against China, Japan, South Korea and other countries as soon as this week, according to a WSJ report.
